Definition: rest, i.e. the state of the dead
BiblicalUsage: This is the world, the land of the living, and Hezekiah uses it from his sickbed when he says he will not see the LORD in the land of the living and will behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world. The world is the place of the living.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hezekiah's fear was that sickness would take him out of the land of the living, and God's answer was fifteen more years in it.
